title: Sudoku Solver

solutions.name: Backtracking
solutions.description: Scan for empty cells. For each empty cell, try digits 1-9. Check validity against row, column, and 3x3 box. If valid, place and recurse. Backtrack on failure.

solutions.name: Backtracking with Bitmask Constraints
solutions.description: Use boolean arrays for rows, columns, and boxes to track which digits are used. Pre-collect empty cells into a list and solve by iterating through them, avoiding repeated scanning.
